''See also: [[Cana Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Cana serves as the capital city of [[Damasca]] and is a significant location within the realm. It features massive stone walls with large metal doors that have historically facilitated the movement of vast numbers of people and goods. The city is also home to a [[Grandmasters' palace]] and a [[Hanging Tree]]. Historically, the city has been subject to destruction, including the burning of its tree, and its architecture has suffered damage from the powers of various [[Incarnations]]. Cana is a central point for travel, as it is the only exit point when traveling through [[Ragnarus the Crimson Vault|Ragnarus]] from the [[Crimson Vault]]. However, the city has recently been isolated by a crimson dome of light that prevents passage through it in any world, effectively sealing the city and making its gates impossible to open via standard travel methods.}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|Cana is a realm that serves as the capital city of [[Damasca]] and houses a royal palace along with a [[Tree]]. Located southeast of the current battlefield, the city is commanded by [[Talos]] and was once visited by [[Simon]] after he met with [[Denner Weeks|Denner]] and [[Indirial]]. Despite being a target for the [[Grandmasters]], who desire to see the city burn, and a potential site for an attack by the [[Damascan army]], Cana is currently inaccessible. This is because [[Incarnation|the Incarnation]] has sealed the location tightly, leaving no way in or out.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Cana serves as the [[Damascan]] capital, a city characterized by its stone walls and massive metal doors set into stone gates. For six months, the location was sealed beneath a crimson barrier and a scarlet dome that turned its sky red. While the [[Overlord of Cana]] borrowed personnel from Feiora, rumors circulated that [[Incarnations]] might be gathering within the city. Although the location can be reached via a Gate, various groups have avoided the area since its barrier fell. Currently, [[King Zakareth VI|King Zakareth]] stands upon the city's walls, which are visible from miles away despite the fact that the top of the fortifications lies in ruins.}}
